 Medicare open enrollment period begins; what’s changing next year
 Lisa Felton Updated 2026년 10월 19일 월 오후 7:54 UTC 0 IOWA — The Medicare open enrollment period is now open for 2027 Medicare Advantage and Part D prescription plans, and thousands of Iowans could see changes in the new year. Plans for more than 87,000 Iowans are being cancelled or discontinued, which means they’ll have to find a new plan. Kristin Griffith with the Iowa […] IOWA -- The Medicare open enrollment period is now open for 2027 Medicare Advantage and Part D prescription plans, and thousands of Iowans could see changes in the new year.
 Iowa’s First Gentleman being treated for recurrence of cancer 
 Plans for more than 87,000 Iowans are being cancelled or discontinued, which means they'll have to find a new plan. 
 Advertisement
 Kristin Griffith with the Iowa Insurance Division joined WHO 13's Samantha Mesa to talk about the changes and where Iowans can find help navigating them. 
 For more information about the Medicare changes, click here . Iowans can also call 1-800-351-4664 for help or call the national Medicare helpline at 1-800-633-4227.
